title: Discord Integration Test
tagline: A copy of Audio Tags For Inworld TTS-2 used to test the Discord bot; safe to delete.
description:
**Test plugin.** This is a copy of the Audio Tags For Inworld TTS-2 bundle, republished under a different name so the SkyrimNet Discord bot can be tested end to end: release announcement, forum post, then this version bump with a changelog.

It will be deleted once the test is done. Do not install it.
author: meimaxmei
changelog: Bumped the version to test the **update** announcement and the forum reply. Nothing else changed.
